intents: Which market are we in, and how big is it?
Is my category growing / what's changing?
How do people buy in my category, and what do others charge?
What are people saying about me and my category?
Watch my brand / tell me if something blows up
Repeat my market research (monthly pulse, quarterly report)
reads: brand brain: summary, kit, products, competitors, learnings, sources, organic, accounts (brand_read); evidence and earlier documents (knowledge_search) — server research and the app (learn-my-brand, unreleased)
buyer groups and the customer-quote bank: workspace research/audience/buyer-groups.md (counts per group) and the latest research/audience/<date>-report.md — research-audience
sibling reports: the latest research/competitors/<date>-report.md and plans/ — research-competitors, plan-campaign
competitor roster (competitor_read) and rival records research/competitors/* — research-competitors
public web: news, analyst estimates, funding, pricing pages, review sites, communities, social platforms' public pages, AI answers — host web search, page fetch and browser (free)
previous run: workspace research/market/* incl. watchlist.md — research-market itself
claims through the claims-gate shared atom — its scoped sign-off, or earlier records (learn-my-brand, unreleased)
shared price history: workspace research/credits-log/<YYYY-MM>.md — any playbook that spends on data
writes: market report (In short, Decisions for you, which market, size top-down and bottom-up, change, buying, pricing, attention, demand, what people are saying, competition in brief, You vs them, disagreements with sibling reports, what it means for positioning, what to do, not doing, baselines, couldn't check, sources with skew): local gooseworks-reports/<brand-slug>/<date>-market-research.md + workspace research/market/<date>-read.md + brand document (keep-history) — read by the founder, plan-campaign, research-audience, research-competitors, analyze-performance, run-organic-social, the next run
brand-watch notes (alerts only, else counts): research/market/watch/<date>.md + document (keep-history) — read by the founder, the next watch, analyze-performance
listening watchlist: research/market/watchlist.md + document (supersede) — this playbook
outlier posts: inspiration library via social_inspiration_save (tag research-market) — makers, work-with-creators, run-organic-social
on yes only: rivals via competitor_save; [market …] and [listening …] rules via save-learning; a monthly pulse / quarterly report or a weekly brand watch via automation_upsert (created paused)
run records: workspace runs/research-market/<job-slug>/<date>.md + brand document (keep-history) through the run-memory shared atom — read by this playbook's next run
